set.body: Implement docs/plans/2026-10-27-graphics-api.md under VISION sections 6–7. G-0 defines standalone public drawing, reusable recording, backend preparation and resource boundaries plus a bounded wgpu/ThorVG comparison protocol. G-1 freezes the general capability inventory, broad authoring corpus and budgets. G-2 delivers the Stage 2 nucleus, standalone and UI-host examples, comparison receipts and backend decision before full renderer expansion. Direct wgpu is the strategic baseline; ThorVG is the first external comparison, not an adopted production dependency. Skia is conditional; no five-backend implementation. G-3 qualifies general capability; G-4 qualifies the broad consumer corpus and separately tracked optional Intaglio adapter/Native portability. Intaglio does not define the core API or block nucleus work. Preserve native ABI/thread/pause gates and kernel semantics; external renderer adoption requires an explicit responsibility update.
set.title: G-0–G-4: General graphics subsystem and renderer qualification
